strings.jp:
おい、見ろよ!
鴨がネギ背負って来たぜ!
strings.en:
Hey, look! A sittin' duck
bringin' its own gravy!

strings.jp: うわぁぁぁ!　お、親分…
やっぱりダメですかい…
strings.en:
Guess it's no good
after all...

strings.jp:
その程度では…
我らは倒せぬ……!
strings.en:
With that much...
you cannot defeat us...!

strings.jp:
や、やった…!
当たりましたぜ、親分!
strings.en:
W-we did it...!
It hit her, Boss!
